title: Mapping spaces in the coherent relative triple pullback
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors and right-pinched mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be quasicategories and let $u^*:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be a simplicial functor. Form the coherent triple quasicategory
$$\mathcal T=\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal A)\times_{\mathcal A,\operatorname{ev}_1,u^*}\mathcal B,$$
whose objects are $(A,F,\eta:A\to u^*F)$ and whose source projection is $r=\operatorname{ev}_0$. For triples $H=(A,F,\eta)$ and $K=(A',F',\eta')$, put
$$S=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal A}(A,A'),\quad V=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal A}(u^*F,u^*F'),\quad R=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal B}(F,F'),\quad M=\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal A)}(\eta,\eta').$$
The right-pinched mapping space in $\mathcal T$ is naturally isomorphic, degree by degree, to the strict pullback
$$M\times_{S\times V}(S\times R),$$
where $M\to S\times V$ records both endpoint maps and $S\times R\to S\times V$ is $(a,b)\mapsto(a,u^*(b))$. This isomorphism commutes with every simplicial operator, with the source projection to $S$, and with simplicial functors commuting with $u^*$ and the displayed endpoints.
